footprints.description: CIT 1000 series SPDT slide switch, PC pin (C) through hole, 3 pins in a line 4.70 mm apart
footprints.note: Switch-1000.pdf p.2 'C, single pole' PC layout (3x dia 1.85 holes, 4.70 pitch, 9.40 overall) and p.2 SPDT outline (body 6.60 across x 12.70 along the slide, p.3 H single rear view 12.70 x 6.60; terminals taken as centred on the body, mounting ears are not on the A-mounting parts). The drawing numbers no terminals: numbered as on the H/V drawings of p.3 (3 at the top, 1 at the bottom; common 2 is the middle one per the p.2 symbol and function table), an assumption. Drawing taken as the top view. Pad = drill 1.85 + 0.6.

footprints.description: CIT 1000 series DPDT slide switch, PC pin (C) through hole, 2 columns of 3 pins 4.83 mm apart
footprints.note: Switch-1000.pdf p.2 'C, double pole' PC layout (6x dia 1.85 holes, 3 rows 4.70 pitch, 9.40 overall, columns 4.83 apart) and p.2 DPDT outline (bottom view 12.70 x 11.43; terminals taken as centred). The drawing numbers no terminals: numbered as the H/V double-pole drawings of p.3 (pins 1-3 one column with 1 at the bottom, 4-6 the other column, 4 beside 1), pins 1-3 in the left column, 4-6 in the right (assumption; the p.2 symbol gives pole 1 = 1-2-3, pole 2 = 4-5-6). Drawing taken as the top view. Pad = drill 1.85 + 0.6.

footprints.description: CIT 1000 series SPDT slide switch, horizontal-mount right angle PC pin (H), 3 pins 4.70 mm apart plus 2 frame legs
footprints.note: Switch-1000.pdf p.3 'H, horizontal mount, right angle PC pins, single pole' layout (5x dia 1.85): the 2 frame-leg holes 13.21 apart, pin 1 9.53 from the legs along x and 1.87 up from the lower leg, pins 1-2-3 4.70 apart (3 at the top). Taken as the top view: the p.3 rear view numbers 1 2 3 left to right, which seen from the top is bottom to top, as in the layout. Body from the p.3 rear view (12.70 along the slide) and the p.2 side view (6.35 deep); the legs sit 0.64 inside the front face and the pins lie behind the body (assumption: legs 0.64 inside the front face, as read on the sibling 1000 series datasheet; the CIT side view has no dimension). Frame legs are copper pins (pin 0), pad = drill + 0.6.

footprints.description: CIT 1000 series SPDT slide switch, vertical-mount right angle PC pin (V), 3 pins 3.81 mm apart plus 2 frame legs
footprints.note: Switch-1000.pdf p.3 'V, vertical mount, right angle PC pins, single pole' layout (5x dia 1.85): the 2 frame-leg holes 4.45 apart, pins 1-2-3 in a row 3.81 apart, pin 1 10.16 from the legs (pins centred between the legs). Drawing taken as the top view with the front (actuator) face at the left, as the p.3 side view. Body 6.60 across (p.3 front view) x 6.35 deep (p.2 side view), the legs 0.64 inside the front face and the pins behind the body (assumption, as for the H footprint). Frame legs are copper pins (pin 0), pad = drill + 0.6.

footprints.description: CIT 1000 series DPDT slide switch, vertical-mount right angle PC pin (V), 2 rows of 3 pins 3.81 mm apart plus 2 frame legs
footprints.note: Switch-1000.pdf p.3 'V, vertical mount, right angle PC pins, double pole' layout (8x dia 1.85): 2 frame-leg holes 4.45 apart, pins 1-2-3 in a row 3.81 apart, pin 1 12.70 from the legs, second row 4-5-6 4.83 away (4 beside 1). Rows centred between the legs (assumption). Drawing taken as the top view with the front (actuator) face at the left. Body 11.43 across (p.2 bottom view) x 6.35 deep (p.2 side view), legs 0.64 inside the front face, pins behind the body (assumption, as for the H footprint). Frame legs are copper pins (pin 0), pad = drill + 0.6.

footprints.description: CIT MS1202 sub-miniature (vertical) SPDT slide switch, PC through hole, 3 pins 3.0 mm apart plus 2 frame pins
footprints.note: Switch-MS1202.pdf p.1 Schematic & PC Layout (PC Layout): 4 to 1 = 2.80, 1-2-3 pitch 3.00, 3 to 5 = 2.80 (11.60 overall, 3X Ø1.00, 2X Ø1.50). Terminals 1, 2, 3 are the circuit pins (Ø1.00 holes, 3.00 pitch); terminals 4 and 5 (frame/shield pins, shown grounded in the schematic) are unnumbered pin 0 pads (Ø1.50 holes, 5.80 from the centre). Pad = drill + 0.6. Layout is the single row on the body's centre line (pins on the centre line of the 5.80 depth in the side view). Body (12.0, 5.8) from the sheet's outline dimensions. Layout shown as seen from the component side (top view); numbering 4 1 2 3 5 left to right.

footprints.description: CIT MS1206 horizontal miniature (right angle) SPDT slide switch, PC through hole, 3 pins 3.0 mm apart plus 2 frame pins
footprints.note: MS1206.pdf p.1 Schematic & PC Layout (PC Layout): 4 to 1 = 3.30, 1-2-3 pitch 3.00, 3 to 5 = 3.30 (12.60 overall, 3X Ø1.00, 2X Ø1.50). Terminals 1, 2, 3 are the circuit pins (Ø1.00 holes, 3.00 pitch); terminals 4 and 5 (frame/shield pins, shown grounded in the schematic) are unnumbered pin 0 pads (Ø1.50 holes, 6.30 from the centre). Layout shown as seen from the component side (top view); numbering 4 1 2 3 5 left to right.

footprints.description: CIT MS1247 right angle sub-miniature SPDT slide switch, PC through hole, 3 pins 2.0 mm apart plus 2 frame pins
footprints.note: Switch-MS1247.pdf p.1 Schematic & PC Layout (PC Layout): 1-2-3 pitch 2.00, 8.40 overall 4 to 5, so 4/5 are 2.20 outside 1/3 (the sheet's 2.23 label is read as 2.2 so that 2.2+2.0+2.0+2.2 = 8.40; the 0.03 difference is below pad tolerance). Terminals 1, 2, 3 are the circuit pins (Ø1.00 holes, 2.00 pitch); terminals 4 and 5 (frame/shield pins, shown grounded in the schematic) are unnumbered pin 0 pads (Ø1.50 holes, 4.20 from the centre). Pad = drill + 0.6. Layout is the single row on the body's centre line (pins on the centre line of the 4.60 side-view depth). Body (8.8, 4.6) from the sheet's outline dimensions. Layout shown as seen from the component side (top view); numbering 4 1 2 3 5 left to right.

footprints.description: CIT MS2201 miniature (vertical) DPDT slide switch, PC through hole, 6 pins in 2 rows plus 4 frame pins
footprints.note: Switch-MS2201.pdf p.1 Schematic & PC Layout (top view, as drawn): Terminals 1-6 are numbered as on the sheet's schematic (1 2 3 on the top row, 4 5 6 on the bottom row, 7/8 left/right); the PC layout drawing itself carries no numbers, so the numbering follows the schematic reading left to right, top to bottom. 6X Ø1.00 holes on a 4.00 x 2.50 grid; 4X Ø1.35 frame holes 15.00 apart (3.50 outside the first column) and 6.30 apart vertically, 7 top-left, 8 top-right, 9 bottom-left, 10 bottom-right. Pad = drill + 0.6. Terminals 7-10 (frame/shield pins, shown grounded in the schematic) are unnumbered pin 0 pads. Body 16.00 x 6.80 from the sheet's outline dimensions, centred on the pin pattern (side view shows the pins symmetric about the body centre line).
